top_signals.title: AMD Falls on Hunterbrook Short Call That Cites China Risks
top_signals.summary: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. shares slid after Hunterbrook Capital said it shorted the stock, following a report by its media affiliate that the chipmaker is reliant on a potentially risky business in China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BP Said to Weigh Divesting Its Key West Africa LNG Plant GTA
top_signals.summary: BP Plc has been considering divesting its majority stake and operatorship of its liquefied natural gas facility off the coast of West Africa, people familiar with the matter said, as chief executive officer Meg O’Neill aims to narrow the energy major’s portfolio.
